summary: Verified DNI column detection fix in importTrafficRows() at /app/frontend/public/v2.html. Injected 5 synthetic CSVs via Playwright (bypassing license modal with localStorage) covering: plain 'DNI' header, 'Nº DOCUMENTO', 'NIF/DNI', unnamed column requiring regex auto-detection, and CSV with no DNI column. Verified render output for both DNI-present and DNI-absent cases. All 7 assertions pass.

test_results.T4_auto_detect_regex: PASS - unnamed 'REF' column with DNI-pattern values auto-detected, all 4 entries populated
test_results.T5_no_DNI_column: PASS - e.dni stays empty/null when CSV lacks DNI
test_results.T6_render_shows_line: PASS - tbody contains 🪪 emoji, DNI value, and required style (font-size:10px + color:#7a8394)
test_results.T7_render_omits_line_when_no_dni: PASS - tbody has NO 🪪 emoji for entries without DNI

critical_code_review_comments: Fix implementation is correct: DNI_KEYWORDS uses .includes() covering 8 variants (DNI, NIE, NIF, DOCUMENTO, IDENTIFICACION, IDENTIFICACIÓN, IDENTIDAD, PASAPORTE), and regex fallback /^[XYZxyz]?\d{5,8}[A-Za-z]?$/ auto-detects when >=70% of values match, requiring >=3 non-empty checked rows.

Render at line 2687 conditionally renders `
🪪 ${dni}
` only when e.dni is truthy — matches spec exactly.
Minor: DNI keyword loop uses `break` after first match; won't detect multi-column ambiguity but acceptable for DGT CSVs.
